purpose: Monitor canonical-Pa four-corner tire pressure, deterministic threshold status, TPMS flags, selected-window history and optional AI narration.
primaryGoal: Identify missing or abnormal corner readings and inspect their history without mistaking missing readings or range-bound timestamps for live evidence.

dataSources.name: Latest pressure
dataSources.sourceOwnership: TirePressureHandler.Latest; router constructor receives stateReader and liveStateReader at internal\api\router.go:1007. Actual backend projection/freshness semantics were not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: Strict non-null vehicle gate; query key tire-pressure-latest plus vehicle ID; abort signal forwarded; inherited query policy. Optional four corner fields and TPMS warning strings preserved.

dataSources.name: Pressure history
dataSources.sourceOwnership: TirePressureHandler.List; history is identified by the page as historical. Server bound interpretation, result completeness and pagination are unverified.
dataSources.behavior: Both literal bounds enter query key and URL; strict non-null vehicle gate; abort signal forwarded; chronological copy for chart, independent sortable copy for table.

dataSources.name: Optional AI trend narration
dataSources.routeEvidence: URL observed in consumer; router handler integration at internal\api\router.go:5078, exact endpoint registration not inspected.
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing withAiFeature gate and AI stream pipeline, not a replacement pressure source.
dataSources.behavior: Opt-in fixed recent-30-day description; vehicle_id body and scopeKey; positive finite vehicle required; independent of selected history range. Stream internals and feature-gate implementation not inspected.

dataSources.name: Workspace and formatting preferences
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Header owns vehicle/date scope; route listed at web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:73. usePressureFormat bridges Pa to the existing kPa formatter only at presentation.
dataSources.behavior: Preserve tire-pressure.range key, units, precision, locale, localization and existing query defaults; do not add a competing selector or conversion engine.

components.behavior: Do not replace shared feedback, semantic severity, typography or motion systems.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Four-corner identity is repeated locally in the page, pressureData, current card and history card. Threshold constants and refresh notice already have one owner; do not duplicate them again.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If consolidating, move the shared corner tuple/type into the existing pressureData domain module and preserve existing test-only exports. No new universal pressure renderer is justified.

evidence: TirePressurePage.tsx:443-479 uses one CardGrid with summary/table full, current third and history half.
AIFeatureCard.tsx:314-337 uses min-w-0, wrapping and break-words.

issues.detail: mobileColumns contains only created_at and warnings. DataTable.tsx:725-726 hides excluded columns below md; its alternative full-detail adapter at 1385 requires mobilePresentation, which this consumer does not supply. The historical four-corner values therefore have no source-wired mobile row-detail alternative here.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing DataTable mobilePresentation contract with all four pressure values and warning/time metadata, preserving filters, sorting, row identity and pagination, or retain all columns in an intentional contained-scroll strategy. Do not build a second table pipeline.

evidence: PressureHistoryCard.tsx:36-49 supplies chart ariaLabel and complete per-corner dataColumns.
PressureCurrentCard.tsx:60-64 retains actual out-of-domain values as text.
TirePressurePage.tsx:422 and feedback corner icons explicitly hide decorative icons.
AIFeatureCard.tsx:297-304 supplies disabled, aria-disabled, aria-busy and action name.

issues.detail: Historical pressure badges vary success/warning/danger but their supplied content is only the numeric reading. Unlike current ThresholdBar, the page supplies no pressure-status text or accessible name for each historical corner.
issues.fix: Add localized status to the existing badge's accessible or visible content while keeping corner/unit column names, numeric values and raw filter values unchanged; verify the composed Badge DOM before acceptance.

states.initialLoading: Current card shows four skeletons; chart/table suppress initial content without data. Summary retains independent per-source loading captions rather than blanking history date. Evidence: PressureCurrentCard.tsx:35-38; PressureHistoryCard.tsx:38; PressureHistoryTable.tsx:25; PressureSummary.tsx:36,45,54,63,80.
states.emptyUnavailable: Current source has empty feedback and retry; individual unknown corners remain visible; history chart/table have empty feedback. readPressurePa excludes null, nonfinite and nonpositive no-reading sentinels without changing payloads.
states.fatalError: deriveDataState feeds QueryError or ChartContainer error and retry independently, not one global data gate. PageLayout receives both queries; layout implementation was not inspected.
states.refreshErrorOfflinePaused: PressureRefreshNotice preserves usable data on refreshError or isRefreshBlocked and offers retry. Summary retained flag reflects either source. Specific browser-offline and stale-age indicators remain unverified.
states.partialUnknown: Latest state marks missing corners partial at TirePressurePage.tsx:247; summary reports measured-corner coverage; history gaps stay null; absent TPMS flags show unknown dash rather than affirmative OK at 387-390.
states.warning: Conditional TPMS alert preserves hard-over-soft severity; threshold warning count is independently calculated from pressure values and explicitly not TPMS flag count.
states.AI: Feature gate, no-vehicle hint, canStart, streaming busy/disabled and existing output error surface are source-wired; no stream executed.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 semantic tokens rather than saturated local palette
visualIssues.detail: pressureColor hardcodes emerald/amber/red hex values at 135-137 and appends alpha 8c for five threshold bands at 219. These are semantic severity colors, but fixed saturated values bypass current theme/token ownership. No page neon/glow/fixed-white class was found by the scoped scan.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing severity/theme token mapping for band fills, preserving thresholds, alpha intent and explicit localized status labels; do not reset user chart colors.

visualIssues.detail: Shared AI button fixes cyan borders/background/focus/text including dark:text-cyan-100; badge at 214 fixes a separate cyan treatment. This is a source-visible saturated branding exception, not proof of poor measured contrast or neon/glow. No literal pure-white or glow treatment was observed in the inspected AI scaffold.
visualIssues.fix: Have the existing AI scaffold owner review subdued semantic accent tokens for badge/action across themes, preserving Helix identity, disabled/busy/focus and localized accessible names. No page-local wrapper or new variant system.

architectureIssues.detail: Page passes useRangeState start/end calendar values to history at 239, rather than startInstant/endInstantExclusive. The hook's separate instant path at useRangeState.ts:656-673 represents rolling live/24h and timezone calendar bounds. This page/hook boundary cannot preserve that instant distinction as written. Server interpretation is not inspected and actual data divergence is unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass the existing instant bounds through the typed pressure history hook, retaining both query-key bounds and cancellation. Coordinate backend bound support/encoding with integration owner; do not implement client filtering or a second date picker.

architectureIssues.detail: History and summary directly import useCardPlacement from layout/layout-reference rather than the layout category; existing domain type imports also point back into the page from pressureData/current/history/table. Type-only imports do not establish a runtime cycle, but page ownership unnecessarily anchors presentation contracts.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the canonical placement export if available and move domain identity into the existing pressure domain owner; preserve all public test helper exports. Verify export availability rather than inventing a wrapper.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 canonical SI; compatibility helpers must stay out of production
architectureIssues.detail: Deprecated normaliseTpmsToPa and exported getTirePressureValue at 121 retain magnitude-based guesses and a zero sentinel. Current rendering uses readPressurePa and the canonical pressure bridge, not these adapters.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep compatibility exports quarantined until directly related tests are migrated; do not reuse guessed-unit helpers or silently remove their existing test contract during presentation work.

priority.reason: Mobile history preservation and exact workspace time-bound propagation take priority over restrained color/token cleanup. Existing page already uses modern layout/domain composites and source-local retained-data handling.
order: Consolidate domain identity without breaking tests

competingImplementations.detail: Test-compatibility magnitude normalizer coexists with canonical readPressurePa/usePressureFormat. It is not used by current production render; unknown downstream usage outside this scope is not asserted.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep canonical readPressurePa plus existing pressure formatting bridge as the sole production path; migrate compatibility tests deliberately, not by deleting helper behavior.

actions: Header-owned selected vehicle and date range, no competing local selector
Independent latest/history retries and retained refresh warnings
Sort timestamp and all four pressure columns, newest-first initial sort
Raw canonical-Pa table filters with preferred-unit labels
DataTable pagination and existing table persistence ID vehicle-systems:tire-pressure-history
Chart hiddenSeries/legend and existing chart key tire-pressure-history
Chart accessible data and export payload passed to canonical frame; actual toolbar behavior unverified
Opt-in AI narration with vehicle scope reset and streaming disabled/busy affordance
Existing unit/precision/locale preferences and localized page/action/status labels
dataBehavior: Wire/query payloads remain canonical Pa and snake_case with unchanged keys and signal cancellation.
Exclude null/nonfinite/nonpositive no-reading values only at presentation; missing corners are never healthy zero measurements.
Mean/min use reported corners only; threshold warning count retains inclusive normal 250000–350000 Pa and explicit coverage.
Threshold soft limits 200000–400000 Pa, geometry domain 150000–450000 Pa; preserve extreme source-value text rather than silently clipping meaning.
Chronological chart copy preserves null gaps and all rows; independent table sort uses Pa magnitudes and timestamp descending default.
History date belongs only to selected window; latest summary has no fabricated observation timestamp.
Absent TPMS flags remain unknown; hard wins over soft; OK only when both flag fields are present and false.
Fatal errors and refresh errors retain distinct rendering; usable neighbors and independent summary/history metrics survive failure.
AI recent-30-day analysis is opt-in, vehicle scoped and distinct from deterministic chart/table selected-window history.
